subject: general
question: At Mumbai's Wankhede Stadium, India defeated Australia by how many wickets in the first ODI of the three match series in March 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**5 wickets**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India defeated **Australia** by** 5 wickets** in the first ODI of the **three-match** series in **March 2023** at Mumbai's **Wankhede** Stadium.
 
• This win gave India a** 1-0 lead** in the series.
 
• Australia won the toss and elected to bat first.
 
• Australia scored **188 runs for 10 wickets in 35.4 overs.**
 
• India chased down the target in** 39.5 overs, losing 5 wickets**.
 
• **KL Rahul (75 not out) and Ravindra Jadeja (45 not out) **were the top scorers for India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A limited-overs cricket match between **two teams** with international status is called a** One Day International (ODI).**
 
• It is played over a set number of overs, typically** 50**, in a single day.
 
• **Limited Overs Internationals** (LOI) is another name for One Day International matches.
 
• **Australia** and** England **played their first One-Day International (ODI) at the Melbourne Cricket Ground on **January 5, 1971**.
